skill.name: mantis-calibrate
skill.description: Calculates the final risk score based on empirical evidence and architectural impact. Use when findings have been fully processed by previous stages and you need to append final risk scores to the finding files. Don't use for discovering new vulnerabilities or writing patches.
skill.summary: Calibrate existing Mantis findings with evidence-based scores, priority caps, snapshot provenance, and an auditable rule checklist.
skill.author: google

security_audit.summary: All 203 static detections are false positives involving Markdown syntax, workflow metadata, or descriptions of vulnerability evidence. One semantic finding identifies helper reuse without integrity verification, enabling code execution if an attacker controls the workspace helper. No evidence found of deliberate prompt injection or data exfiltration in the supplied files.

remediation.issue: Existing helper code is trusted based only on a version comment.
remediation.suggestion: Regenerate helpers from a trusted template or verify their complete contents before execution. Reject symlinks and use a private, access-controlled helper directory.

semantic_findings.title: Workspace Helper Reuse Without Integrity Verification
semantic_findings.description: The skill executes an existing workspace helper after checking only "# MANTIS_HELPER_VERSION = 2". An attacker controlling that helper can retain the comment and execute arbitrary code with agent permissions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly combine helper execution with a first-line version check, without requiring body verification. Exploitation requires attacker control of the workspace helper; no malicious helper is supplied.

content.value_statement: Security findings need consistent priorities grounded in exploit evidence and architectural context. This skill applies a risk matrix and documented caps to existing Mantis findings.
actual_capabilities: Calculate impact, likelihood, context multipliers, final risk scores, and remediation priorities for eligible findings.
Evaluate all 27 calibration rules and record applied caps, unresolved rules, and supporting reasons.
Use threat models and attacker-position metadata to determine exposure and asset criticality.
Track snapshot provenance and prevent selected stale-evidence heuristics from changing scores.
Update finding files with calibration fields, executive summaries, and history entries.
Generate a reusable workspace helper for updating subsequent finding files.
limitations: Requires existing Mantis finding files and relevant pipeline evidence; it does not discover vulnerabilities or write patches.
Scores depend on evidence quality, declared metadata, threat models, and agent interpretation.
Snapshot safeguards apply only when snapshot state exists; default mode does not check provenance.
Existing helpers require independent integrity review because the prescribed version check does not verify executable contents.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Existing Vulnerabilities
use_cases.description: Calibrate completed findings with exploit evidence, exposure, and blast radius to support remediation planning.

use_cases.title: Review Project Threat Context
use_cases.description: Apply project threat models and asset criticality when assessing findings across internal components and public interfaces.

use_cases.title: Track Evidence Across Pipeline Passes
use_cases.description: Record snapshot provenance, stale evidence, and unresolved calibration rules in finding histories for later review.

prompt_templates.title: Review Calibration Inputs
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my existing Mantis findings without modifying files. Identify missing reproduction, viability, and threat-model information needed for calibration.

prompt_templates.title: Calibrate a Finding
prompt_templates.prompt: Calibrate finding [finding_id] using its evidence and threat model. Explain the score, priority, and applicable caps before updating the file.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Unresolved Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Review calibrated findings for UNKNOWN rules and stale evidence. Explain which priorities remain provisional and what evidence would resolve each warning.

prompt_templates.title: Calibrate a Pinned Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Calibrate findings using [snapshot_root] and [state_root]. Verify pass alignment, preserve conservative scores for stale evidence, and review helper integrity before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: process findings with explicit snapshot provenance.

output_examples.input: Impact 4, likelihood 3, internal exposure, viable production finding, and no additional caps.
output_examples.output: Risk score: 5.6. Priority: MEDIUM. Internal exposure applies a 0.8 multiplier to the combined impact and likelihood.

output_examples.input: A pinned finding has failed reproduction, but its discovery snapshot does not match the active snapshot.
output: STALE_EVIDENCE: reproduction evidence does not match the active snapshot.
Reproduction failure rule: UNKNOWN. Do not force LOW based on stale evidence.
Keep the conservative calculated score and record the provenance warning.

output_examples.input: A viable finding has an unresolved physical-access prerequisite during calibration.
output_examples.output: Calibration is provisional. Mark the physical-access rule UNKNOWN, retain the calculated priority, and request evidence resolving the prerequisite.

best_practices: Provide reproduction results, production viability, attacker prerequisites, and a current threat model before calibration.
Use matching pinned snapshots and review every stale-evidence or UNKNOWN warning before accepting priorities.
Back up finding files and verify complete helper contents before executing generated or reused scripts.
anti_patterns: Use calibration to discover new vulnerabilities or implement patches.
Treat missing reproduction or threat-model information as proof that a finding is harmless.
Execute existing workspace helpers solely because their version comment matches.

faq.question: What does this skill calculate?
faq.answer: It calculates impact, likelihood, context-adjusted risk scores, and priorities for eligible existing Mantis findings.

faq.question: Does it find vulnerabilities or fix code?
faq.answer: No. It calibrates findings already produced by earlier pipeline stages and updates their reporting fields.

faq.question: What happens when evidence fields are missing?
faq.answer: Missing viability defaults to CONDITIONAL_VIABLE, and missing reproduction defaults to not_attempted. Applicable rules can reduce priority, except where stale-evidence safeguards apply.

faq.question: Does calibration require a pinned snapshot?
faq.answer: No. Without active snapshot state, it uses default mode without provenance checks. Pinned and HALT modes enable conservative stale-evidence handling.

faq.question: Which files can it change?
faq.answer: It updates workspace finding files and creates a reusable calibration helper. Pinned target source must remain unchanged.

faq.question: Is the helper version check sufficient for security?
faq.answer: No. A matching comment does not establish integrity. Review complete helper contents or regenerate from trusted templates before execution.
